frozen_nuisance_source: PR46 family-wise alpha-risk nuisance decision freeze

decision_semantics.baseline: no observed deviation -> no attribution query; baseline is not a negative class
decision_semantics.target: frozen target observer supports target and frozen nuisance decision does not support nuisance
decision_semantics.nuisance: frozen nuisance decision supports nuisance and frozen target observer does not support target
decision_semantics.undetermined_information_absent: observed deviation but neither target nor nuisance can be safely supported
decision_semantics.undetermined_overlap_or_attribution: both positive supports coexist or indirect-only local response cannot be safely attributed

forced_binary_contract.question: target/visit present versus absent
forced_binary_contract.coercion: U and baseline are forced to target-absent; target is positive; nuisance is negative
forced_binary_contract.false_positive: forced binary positive when latent target truth is false
forced_binary_contract.false_negative: forced binary negative when latent target truth is true

partial_identification_contract.rationale: baseline is outside the attribution question and must not be silently treated as target absence

claim_boundary: closed-world frozen-observer phase-surface measurement; empirical systems later locate themselves on this surface
